endorsements.quote: Further, the design and delivery of oART training for a global audience may benefit from a modular approach tailored to regional needs.

One approach is to develop structured, modular training programs that can be customised to different regions, taking into account local resources, local jurisdiction limitations, MDT make up, and technological capabilities.

unlisted_practices: Establish a globally standardised, consensus-based oART training curriculum for radiation therapists.
Governments and governing bodies should prioritise healthcare workforce development by allocating funds and creating policies that support oART training.
Use online platforms and regional training hubs or centres of excellence to disseminate oART training worldwide.
Create partnerships with leading institutions to provide remote mentorship for regions with limited oART expertise.
Establish industry-sponsored global expertise partnerships to fund and sustain oART training programs.
Incorporate hands-on experiential training with mentorship, and continuous assessment and feedback loops, into oART training programs.
Review undergraduate radiation therapy training globally to prepare the workforce for advanced adaptive technologies.
Provide formal professional recognition and advanced practice pathways for radiation therapists who take on expanded oART roles.

screen.reason: Commentary proposing standards for a global training curriculum for radiation therapy professionals in online adaptive radiation therapy (oART), including leveraging AI.
